blocks.text: Bowers & Wilkins Px7 S3 Over Ear Headphones for True SoundBowers & Wilkins Px7 S3 over ear headphones redefines premium wireless listening with high-resolution audio, cutting-edge noise cancellation, and an ultra-comfortable design. These over-ear headphones bring you closer to your music with unparalleled clarity, depth, and precision. The custom-tuned 40mm bio-cellulose drivers work alongside a 24-bit digital signal processor to deliver rich, natural sound that stays true to the original recording.Whether you’re working, traveling, or simply unwinding, Px7 S3’s advanced active noise cancellation adapts to your surroundings, filtering out unwanted noise while preserving every musical detail. With eight strategically placed microphones, background distractions fade away, while your voice remains crystal clear for calls and voice commands.Crafted for long listening sessions, Px7 S3 combines plush memory foam ear cushions, an ergonomically designed headband, and a lightweight yet durable frame. Enjoy up to 30 hours of playtime on a single charge, and with fast-charging capabilities, you’ll always have music when you need it. Integrated voice controls using the Bowers & Wilkins Music App make it easy to personalize your experience, ensuring the perfect balance of sound, style, and convenience.

items: ICONIC PX7 SERIES, REIMAGINED & REFINED - Re-engineered for exceptional comfort, clarity, depth, and precision, the Bowers & Wilkins Px7 S3 Over-Ear headphones feature 40mm drivers and 24-bit DSP to deliver rich hi-res sound true to artist's vision

ADJUST AUTOMATICALLY FOR STUNNING AUDIO - With aptX Lossless and aptX Adaptive support, Px7 S3 dynamically optimizes performance & connection between your headphones and music source for incredible clarity across your music, calls, movies, and games

NOISE-CANCELLING HEADPHONES WITH MIC - Shut out unwanted noise & focus on music with our active noise-canceling wireless headphones featuring (8) precision-tuned microphones, effectively blocking out distractions to ensure crystal clear call quality

JOY TO WEAR ALL DAY LONG - Designed to provide a comfy fit to all differing head shapes, these Bluetooth headphones feature our plush memory foam ear cushions, a refined lightweight headband, & elegant fabric finish for our most comfortable fit yet

CHARGES FAST & PLAYS ALL DAY LONG - Enjoy uninterrupted listening with up to 30 hours of battery life on a single charge. Plus, a quick charge of 15 minutes delivers 7 hours of playback, ideal for commute, office, travel, or on-the-go lifestyles

SEAMLESS SETUP WITH OUR APP - The Bowers & Wilkins Music app puts you in control, letting you fine-tune every note with a 5-band EQ, set noise cancellation to suit your surroundings, adjust audio preferences, access your phone's voice control & more

ARTISTIC PRECISION - Bowers & Wilkins Headphones bring you evolved performance, crafted by experts for a truly immersive experience. Capturing the artist's intent, these headphones offer precision and depth, letting you immerse yourself in true sound
